company.description:
Arrow is a mobile commerce platform for making it easy to sell big stuff easier. It offers turnkey CRM solution that powers the business into the digital world. The company generates, manages, and organizes their leads with ArrowShare to get the most out of their data and spend. They streamline closing with DealMode, removing the unnecessary back and forth, and have access to the closing tools from anywhere via mobile or desktop.

Arrow was founded by Charles Anderson and Logan Murphy in 2020 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, California, USA.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $14,434,135, or 90.33% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,761,727 to $78,133,505, a 16.41x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
